scfishbot.stop.no_rod: no Starcatcher rod in hand or hotbar
scfishbot.configuration.title: Starcatcher FishBot Settings
scfishbot.configuration.default_mode.too: Mode the bot starts in when you join a world. OFF, ASSIST (minigame only) or FULL (cast, hook, minigame, recast).
scfishbot.configuration.announce_state_c: Show an action-bar message when the bot is toggled, paused or stopped.
scfishbot.configuration.collect_treasure: Hit treasure sweet-spots to fill the treasure bar.
scfishbot.configuration.treasure_priorit: While a treasure is still being collected, hold back fish hits that would finish the catch early.
scfishbot.configuration.treasure_hold_pe: With treasure priority on, fish progress is held below this fraction of the goal until the treasure is complete.
scfishbot.configuration.avoid_negative_s: Never hit sweet-spots whose reward is negative.
scfishbot.configuration.handle_multi_lay: Automatically switch handle layers on multi-layer (A/D) minigames.
scfishbot.configuration.hit_interval_jit: Random extra milliseconds added after each press, for more human-looking timing.
0 = press as soon as the handle touches a sweet-spot, 0.9 = wait until it is near the centre. The bot always presses before the handle leaves the spot.
scfishbot.configuration.skip_chance.tool: Chance (0-1) to deliberately let a sweet-spot pass, imitating a late reaction. Never causes a miss penalty.
scfishbot.configuration.start_delay_ms.t: Milliseconds to wait after the minigame opens before the first press.
scfishbot.configuration.hook_delay_min_t: Minimum reaction time in ticks before hooking a bite (20 ticks = 1 second). Bites expire after 80 ticks.
scfishbot.configuration.hook_delay_max_t: Maximum reaction time in ticks before hooking a bite.
scfishbot.configuration.recast_delay_min: Minimum ticks to wait before casting again.
scfishbot.configuration.recast_delay_max: Maximum ticks to wait before casting again.
scfishbot.configuration.bite_timeout_sec: Reel in and recast if nothing bites for this many seconds. 0 disables.
scfishbot.configuration.flying_timeout_s: Reel in and recast if the bobber has not landed in liquid after this many seconds.
Switch to a Starcatcher rod from the hotbar when none is held, or when the held rod is too damaged.
scfishbot.configuration.min_rod_durabili: Never fish with a rod at or below this much durability left. 0 disables.
scfishbot.configuration.stop_when_bait_e: Stop when the rod's bait slot is empty.
scfishbot.configuration.stop_when_invent: Stop when the inventory has no free slot.
scfishbot.configuration.stop_on_damage.t: Stop full-auto when you take damage.
scfishbot.configuration.min_health_perce: Stop full-auto when health falls below this fraction of max health. 0 disables.
scfishbot.configuration.hostile_pause_ra: Pause casting while a hostile mob is within this many blocks. 0 disables.
scfishbot.configuration.max_catches.tool: Stop after this many successful catches in one session. 0 = unlimited.
scfishbot.configuration.max_session_minu: Stop full-auto after this many minutes. 0 = unlimited.
scfishbot.configuration.alert_rarity.too: Announce catches of this rarity or better in chat. NONE disables.
scfishbot.configuration.alert_sound.tool: Play a sound with rarity alerts.
scfishbot.configuration.chat_catch_summa: Print a short chat line after every minigame.
scfishbot.configuration.log_catches_to_f: Append every minigame result to <game dir>/scfishbot/catches.csv.
scfishbot.configuration.hud_show_when_of: Keep the overlay visible while the bot is OFF.
scfishbot.configuration.hud_top_fish_lin: How many of the most-caught items to list on the overlay.
